facts.fact: 章首：逐根点燃手指——火焰治愈断骨暗影束缚逃离摔落
facts.anchor: Heart pounding in her ears, Andra ignited her fingertips one by one. With each crackle of flames

facts.fact: 连发两团火球直击 Vasara——银发发梢冒烟
facts.anchor: Forming two balls of flames, she released them one after the other, straight at Vasara.

facts.fact: 沸腾之雨：聚拢水汽凝穹顶烧开——红眼乌鸦烫死落地
facts.anchor: before they could leave the ground, boiling rain poured down in sheets, their bodies left twitching where they lay.

facts.fact: 人质反转：Vasara 押 Gerrick 用骨刃抵喉割出血线——喝令撤火圈
facts.anchor: He was kneeling once more, and his head was bent back with the bone blade pressed firmly to his throat.

facts.fact: 黑根爆发：粗过大腿的藤根破地缠死 Vasara——魔法与她合而为一以她的血为燃料
facts.anchor: Andra’s magic exploded as black roots thicker than her thighs erupted through the floor.

facts.fact: 处刑：拾骨刃"Edgeron？替我问好"——刺入 Vasara 心脏杀死她
facts.anchor: Andra screamed and plunged the blade into the dark magic wielder's heart.

facts.fact: 骨刃刺穿翡翠——力量将她击飞仰面倒地宝石开裂
facts.anchor: Inhaling deeply, Andra shoved the blade through the emerald.

facts.fact: 意识空间：苍白黑发男子歪嘴一笑眨眼——"终于见到你了"（Edgeron 亲自打招呼）
facts.anchor: A lopsided smile formed on his lips as slithering black lines poked from under his collar, and he winked.

facts.fact: 男声警告：翡翠若死 Gerrick 也会像怪物们一样死——Gerrick 捂胸倒下
facts.anchor: He will die like the others if the emerald dies.

facts.fact: 指点：宝石破损需一个宿主——"把宝石带到血那里去否则他会死"
facts.anchor: With such damage, it needs a host, little one.

facts.fact: Nelveen 赶到按胸止血转述 Quentin 警讯：各处通道打开怪物遍地必须撤
facts.anchor: “Quentin says all sorts of gates are opening. There are monsters everywhere.” Nelveen was terrified. “We have to run.”

facts.fact: 章末：剖胸骨长口把翡翠塞进胸腔作宿主——血涌满喉咙；Gerrick 复活抱住她"直到我最后一口气"后黑暗吞没
facts.anchor: In one swift movement, Andra cut a long line down the length of her sternum and shoved the emerald inside.
